Both components pass design critique gate (≥90/100, zero ZERO-FLORA violations)
ValidationDashboard.tsx decomposed into ≤4 sub-components each ≤200 lines
No sub-component calls geminiService or Firebase directly
API callbacks (onRequestAI, onSaveProfile) wired to correct backend endpoints
All harvested files pass vercel-composition-patterns and vercel-react-best-practices audit
